description: This file defines the 'Header' struct and associated methods for parsing and generating gettext PO file headers, specific to the 'po' package.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents the header information of a gettext PO file, including metadata fields and unknown fields.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.description: Parses a Message object to populate the Header fields based on header lines.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Header in PO file header format.
